title: is done was done (passive 1)
summary: Страдательный залог в настоящем и прошедшем: **is / are / was / were + причастие** — когда важно действие, а не тот, кто его делает.
ru:
## Что такое пассив
В активном предложении делающий действие — подлежащее: «Кто-то убирает офис». В пассиве на первом месте то, **с чем** делают: «Офис убирается».
> Somebody **cleans** the office every day. (актив)
> The office **is cleaned** every day. — Офис убирают каждый день. (пассив)

Пассив используем, когда нам неважно или неизвестно, кто делает.

## Как образуется
> **am / is / are** + причастие (present simple passive)
> **was / were** + причастие (past simple passive)

Причастие у правильных глаголов = **-ed** (cleaned, painted), у неправильных — третья форма (made, built, taken, stolen).
> Butter **is made** from milk. — Масло делают из молока.
> These rooms **are cleaned** every day. — Эти комнаты убирают каждый день.
> This house **was built** 100 years ago. — Этот дом построили 100 лет назад.
> The windows **were broken** last night. — Окна разбили прошлой ночью.

## Отрицание и вопрос
> I'm never invited to parties. — Меня никогда не приглашают на вечеринки.
> We **weren't** invited. — Нас не пригласили.
> **When was** the telephone invented? — Когда изобрели телефон?
> **How often are** the rooms cleaned? — Как часто убирают комнаты?

## was / were born
По-русски «я родилась» — глагол в прошедшем. По-английски — только пассив в прошедшем.
> I **was born** in 1998. — Я родилась в 1998 году.
> Where **were** you **born**? — Где ты родилась?
- ~~I am born in Osh.~~ → I **was born** in Osh.

## by — кем сделано
Если важно, кто делает, добавляем **by**.
> The telephone was invented **by** Alexander Bell. — Телефон изобрёл Александр Белл.
> My brother was bitten **by** a dog. — Моего брата укусила собака.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~The house built in 1990.~~ → The house **was built** in 1990. (be обязателен)
- ~~It was invent in 1876.~~ → It was **invented** in 1876. (нужно причастие)
en:
## What is the passive?
In an active sentence the subject does the action: "Somebody cleans the office". In a passive sentence the subject is the thing that receives the action: "The office is cleaned".
> Somebody **cleans** the office every day. (active)
> The office **is cleaned** every day. (passive)

We use the passive when we don't know who does the action, or it isn't important.

## How to form it
> **am / is / are** + past participle (present simple passive)
> **was / were** + past participle (past simple passive)

Regular past participles end in **-ed** (cleaned, painted). Irregular ones are different (made, built, taken, stolen).
> Butter **is made** from milk.
> These rooms **are cleaned** every day.
> This house **was built** 100 years ago.
> The windows **were broken** last night.

## Negative and questions
> I'm never invited to parties.
> We **weren't** invited.
> **When was** the telephone invented?
> **How often are** the rooms cleaned?

## was / were born
We always say **was / were born** (not *am born*).
> I **was born** in 1998.
> Where **were** you **born**?

## by ...
We use **by** to say who did the action.
> The telephone was invented **by** Alexander Bell.
> My brother was bitten **by** a dog.

## Common mistakes
- ~~The house built in 1990.~~ → The house **was built** in 1990.
- ~~It was invent in 1876.~~ → It was **invented** in 1876.
- ~~I am born in Osh.~~ → I **was born** in Osh.
structure:
## Present simple passive
| Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|
| The room is cleaned. | The room isn't cleaned. | Is the room cleaned? |
| I am invited. | I'm not invited. | Am I invited? |
| The rooms are cleaned. | The rooms aren't cleaned. | Are the rooms cleaned? |

## Past simple passive
| Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|
| The house was built. | The house wasn't built. | Was the house built? |
| The houses were built. | The houses weren't built. | Were the houses built? |

## Формула
> Подлежащее + **am / is / are / was / were** + past participle (+ **by** + кто)

## Краткие ответы
- Was it made in China? — Yes, it **was**. / No, it **wasn't**.
- Are they sold here? — Yes, they **are**. / No, they **aren't**.

## Правописание причастия
- clean → cleaned, paint → painted
- love → loved (+d), study → studied (y → ied)
- неправильные: make → made, build → built, steal → stolen, take → taken, write → written

exercises.title: Present simple passive
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в present simple passive.
exercises.example: (the rooms / clean) → The rooms are cleaned.

items.text: These cars {{are made|'re made}} in Japan.
The shops {{are closed|'re closed}} on Sundays.
English {{is spoken|'s spoken}} all over the world.
I {{am never invited|'m never invited}} to their parties.

exercises.title: Past simple passive
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в past simple passive (was / were + причастие).

items.text: Two people {{were taken}} to hospital after the accident.
My phone {{was stolen|was taken}} last week.
These letters {{weren't written|were not written}} by me.

options: This picture was painted by Picasso.
This picture is painted by Picasso yesterday.

exercises.title: Актив → пассив
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение в пассиве (в конце — недостающая часть).
exercises.example: Somebody cleans the room. → The room is cleaned.

items.text: Somebody locks the door at night. → The door {{is locked}} at night.
Somebody made this cake yesterday. → This cake {{was made}} yesterday.
People grow rice in Asia. → Rice {{is grown}} in Asia.
Somebody stole my bag. → My bag {{was stolen}}.
They build many houses here. → Many houses {{are built}} here.
Alexander Bell invented the telephone. → The telephone {{was invented}} by Alexander Bell.

answers: The office is cleaned every day.
Are these rooms cleaned every day?
The film was not made in 2010.
My car was stolen last night.
